messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer (AcmeCorp) hit a 403 on generation endpoints but embeddings work. They say the key was provisioned via SSO/SCIM as an org-level API key. Copying their curl+response below so we have exact repro. Can someone take a look?

Customer curl:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer org_live_XXXX\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Response body:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "insufficient_scope", "missing_scopes": ["generation","rerank"], "message": "API key missing required scopes" }
```
They also tried /v1/embeddings and that succeeds. Customer says they only use the org key for deployments and cannot easily create a user key. Ticket CS-99827 opened.

aj_reliability: Got it — thanks for the details. Can you share the key_id (starts with org_) and the org id? Also, can you run a quick inspect from console or the keys API so we can see the scopes on the key? Example CLI we use: `redwood keys inspect org_live_XXXX` or `GET /v1/internal/keys/org_live_XXXX` (admin token). If you prefer, paste the JSON from the admin console.

maria_cs: Key id is org_live_7K2b... Org id: org_acme_21. Customer pasted the admin console view: 
```
{
  "id": "org_live_7K2b...",
  "owner": "org_acme_21",
  "created_by": "provisioning-service",
  "scopes": ["embeddings.read","embeddings.write"],
  "type": "org",
  "note": "SSO provisioned org key"
}
```

aj_reliability: That output nails it — only embeddings scopes. Generation and rerank not present. Likely cause: the SSO provisioning role->key template no longer includes inference scopes. Did we roll a template change recently?

tim_sre: Yep — there was a change on 2026-03-10 to the org-default provisioning template: `org-default` had its scopes reduced to minimize blast radius for new org keys. Somehow inference scopes (generation, rerank) got removed instead of being gated under a feature flag. Provisioning-service creates org keys from that template, so any org provisioned after the change would get the restricted scopes.

lucas_prod: Confirmed in audit logs. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-10T14:02:11Z provisioning-service INFO created_key id=org_live_7K2b owner=org_acme_21 template=org-default template_version=2026-03-10
```
That matches the customer's key creation time.

tim_sre: Short term options:
- Re-issue a new org key for them with full scopes (inference, rerank, embeddings) and ask them to rotate to it.
- Or create a user/service-account key for them to use as a stopgap.
Longer term: rollback or patch the provisioning template and backfill keys for recently provisioned orgs that need full scopes.

aj_reliability: We should avoid blind mass-backfill. For now, create a targeted remediation for org_acme_21 only. I'll open an internal eng ticket to implement a safe reissue flow and audit keys that were issued with the reduced template. ENG-3456 created.

maria_cs: Customer needs immediate instructions they can do right now — they cannot wait for a full backfill. Can you paste the exact admin API call I can run to create a replacement org key with the necessary scopes? I'll perform it with their consent.

tim_sre: Use the internal admin endpoint (requires admin token):
```
POST /internal/admin/keys/issue
Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "owner": "org_acme_21",
  "type": "org",
  "scopes": ["inference.generate","inference.stream","rerank","embeddings.read","embeddings.write"],
  "note": "temporary reissue for customer CS-99827 - replace and rotate"
}
```
Response will include a new key. Steps to rotate with the customer: 1) Create new key, 2) Have customer update deployments to use new key, 3) Verify generation endpoints work, 4) Revoke old key via admin console.

lucas_prod: I'll pull the audit trail and confirm which orgs created keys with template_version=2026-03-10 so we can proactively reach out. For now, please run the admin call for Acme only.

aj_reliability: Added a note in ENG-3456 to add a safe backfill utility and to add an inbox for keys provisioned with reduced scopes. Also flagged docs so customer-facing docs explain the difference between org and user keys.

support-bot: Ticket CS-99827 created: https://redwood.ai/customer/cs/tickets/CS-99827 — assigned to maria_cs.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll run the admin call now and share the new key with the customer using the secure sharing flow. I'll also include the rotation steps above and ask them to validate generation + rerank. Once they confirm, we'll revoke the old key. I'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

tim_sre: One more note: mark this as P1 internal (SSO provisioning user-impact) so eng can prioritize the template patch. Also add an FAQ to prevent external teams from using org keys for latency-sensitive gen traffic without checking scopes.

maria_cs: Will do. Followup: I'll DM @aj_reliability and @lucas_prod the org id and start the reissue now. Will update ticket CS-99827 when customer confirms.
